terra.problem: The passage does not say whether anyone asked for a second opinion. Joseph coming from the dungeon is outside this passage and needs a reference.
Joseph explaining the dreams and proposing a food-storage plan are facts from outside this passage and need a reference.
The explanation treats Pharaoh's throne as a literal chair rather than his superior position as king.
Joseph did not arrive in dungeon clothes: he changed clothes before coming to Pharaoh (Genesis 41:14). The passage also does not establish that he walked out that same day.
The text does not say the men rode ahead of Joseph in the chariot or that he was in the dungeon a few days earlier. The dungeon detail also needs a reference.
Joseph's time in the dungeon is outside this passage and needs a reference.
The passage says the food came from fields around each city; it does not mention city walls.
Joseph stopped keeping track, but the text does not say nobody was writing numbers down.
The text does not say Joseph held Manasseh in his arms.
Pharaoh having dreams is a fact from outside this passage. The reference given does not cover that fact.
The text says no one could interpret Pharaoh's dreams; it does not say the magicians never got to say anything useful.
The text does not say Joseph started the day in a dungeon. His time there is also outside this passage and needs a reference.
The explanation gives Joseph having food as Pharaoh's reason for sending the people to him, but the text does not state Pharaoh's reason.
The explanation says the Ishmaelites were among those coming to buy grain, but the passage does not identify them as being there.
